title_en: Notice of the Supreme People's Court on Issuing the Implementation Measures on the Implementation of the Work Plan for Establishing a Sound System for Combating and Preventing Corruption (2008-2012)
full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court

Notice on Issuing the Implementation Measures for Implementing the Work Plan for Establishing a Sound System for Punishing and Preventing Corruption (2008-2012)

Fa Fa [2008] No. 26

All local people's courts at various levels, all military courts, all railway transport intermediate courts and basic courts, all maritime courts, and all courts of the Xinjiang Production and Construction Corps:

To thoroughly implement the spirit of the Seventeenth National Congress of the Communist Party of China and implement the CPC Central Committee's Work Plan for Establishing a Sound System for Punishing and Preventing Corruption (2008-2012), and to further strengthen the anti-corruption and integrity building of the people's courts with a focus on the system for punishing and preventing corruption, we hereby issue the Implementation Measures for Implementing the Work Plan for Establishing a Sound System for Punishing and Preventing Corruption (2008-2012) of the Supreme People's Court to you. Please implement it conscientiously in light of actual circumstances.

This document is also copied to the Party committees, people's congresses, discipline inspection commissions, and political and legal affairs committees of all provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the Central Government, as well as the Party Committee, Discipline Inspection Commission, and Political and Legal Affairs Committee of the Xinjiang Production and Construction Corps. Please have all higher people's courts and the branch of the Xinjiang Production and Construction Corps deliver it on behalf of the Supreme People's Court.

August 19, 2008

Supreme People's Court

Implementation Measures for Implementing the Work Plan for Establishing a Sound System for Punishing and Preventing Corruption (2008-2012)

To comprehensively implement the spirit of the Seventeenth National Congress of the Communist Party of China and implement the CPC Central Committee's Work Plan for Establishing a Sound System for Punishing and Preventing Corruption (2008-2012) (hereinafter referred to as the Work Plan), and to solidly advance the establishment of a system for punishing and preventing corruption in the people's courts, these Implementation Measures are formulated.

1. Guiding Ideology and Work Objectives

Resolutely punishing and effectively preventing corruption in the judicial field is crucial to the success or failure of the people's judicial cause and to judicial fairness and judicial authority. It is a major political task that the people's courts must always grasp firmly. At present, the people's courts face many new situations and new problems in Party conduct, integrity building, and the fight against corruption. The situation remains severe, and the task remains arduous. People's courts at all levels must fully recognize the long-term, complex, and arduous nature of the anti-corruption struggle. While actively playing their role in the anti-corruption functions of the people's courts, they must, in accordance with the requirements of the Work Plan, focus on improving the system for punishing and preventing corruption in the people's courts and unswervingly advance anti-corruption and integrity building in the people's courts.

People's courts at all levels must hold high the great banner of socialism with Chinese characteristics, take Deng Xiaoping Theory and the important thought of Three Represents as guidance, thoroughly implement the Scientific Outlook on Development, always adhere to the guiding ideology of putting the Party's cause first, the people's interests first, and the Constitution and laws first, adhere to the policy of addressing both symptoms and root causes, comprehensive governance, combining punishment with prevention, and focusing on prevention, and place anti-corruption and integrity building in the people's courts in a more prominent position. Closely combining the actual situation of the people's courts, in accordance with new circumstances and tasks, they must comprehensively advance all work in establishing the system for punishing and preventing corruption in the people's courts, providing a strong guarantee for strengthening team building, ensuring judicial fairness, and maintaining judicial authority.

The work objectives for the next five years are to establish a basic framework for the system for punishing and preventing corruption in the people's courts, initially establish a long-term mechanism for education on resisting corruption and preventing degeneration, relatively improve various anti-corruption and integrity systems, effectively utilize the supervisory role of the mechanism for monitoring the exercise of power, achieve phased results in judicial system reform to prevent corruption at the source, significantly improve the trial style, reduce corruption in the court team to a minimum, significantly increase the people's satisfaction with court work, and bring anti-corruption and integrity building in the people's courts to a new level.

2. Advancing Anti-Corruption and Integrity Education

(1) Strengthening Education on Party Conduct and Integrity for Leading Cadres at All Levels of the People's Courts

The Work Plan proposes strengthening education on Party conduct and integrity for leading cadres.

First, it is necessary to conduct in-depth education on ideals, beliefs, and clean governance among leading cadres at all levels of the courts. Leading cadres at all levels of the courts must seriously study the theoretical system of socialism with Chinese characteristics, deeply grasp the scientific connotation, spiritual essence, and fundamental requirements of the Scientific Outlook on Development, firmly establish the lofty ideal of communism and the common ideal of socialism with Chinese characteristics, firmly establish a Marxist worldview, outlook on life, and values, firmly establish a correct view of power, status, and interests, and a socialist view of honor and disgrace; seriously study the important thoughts on anti-corruption and integrity of the three generations of the Party's central leadership and the important expositions on anti-corruption and integrity of the Party Central Committee with Comrade Hu Jintao as General Secretary; seriously study the Party Constitution and other intra-Party regulations and national laws and regulations; strengthen Party spirit cultivation and political integrity cultivation; enhance legal awareness and discipline awareness; and lay a solid ideological and political foundation for clean governance. After the Opinions on Strengthening Anti-Corruption and Integrity Education for Leading Cadres proposed in the Work Plan is formulated and issued, people's courts at all levels must implement it conscientiously in light of actual circumstances. By the end of 2008, people's courts at all levels must further improve the study system of the Party Leadership Group Center, arranging at least two or more theoretical study sessions on anti-corruption and integrity each year. The president of each people's court must take the lead in giving lectures on integrity, delivering at least one targeted integrity lecture to the entire court each year. Vice presidents and other leading members must give at least one integrity lecture in their respective departments each year. Newly appointed leading cadres must undergo integrity conversations upon taking office. Anti-corruption and integrity education must be included in the education and training plans for leading cadres, incorporated into the teaching plans of Party schools, judge colleges, and other cadre training institutions, and the integrity education for leading cadres must be effectively implemented.

Second, it is necessary to carry out education on Party conduct and discipline among leading cadres at all levels of the courts. Leading cadres at all levels of the courts must actively participate in thematic education on Party conduct and discipline organized by discipline inspection commissions at all levels and by organizational and propaganda departments, consciously abide by the Party's political discipline, organizational discipline, and mass work discipline, emphasize Party spirit, value conduct, and set an example. They must effectively improve the conduct of leading cadres, focus on solving prominent problems in ideological style, study style, work style, leadership style, and lifestyle, enhance the awareness of public service, maintain close ties with the masses, and be dedicated to the people, pragmatic, and honest. They must carry forward the Party's glorious traditions, bear in mind the "Two Musts," and promote eight aspects of good conduct. They must carry forward the spirit of hard work, conscientiously implement various regulations on official receptions, vigorously streamline meetings and documents, and improve meeting style and writing style.

(2) Strengthening Judicial Integrity Education for Staff of the People's Courts

In accordance with the spirit of the Work Plan, people's courts at all levels must organize, on a concentrated basis each year, all judges and other staff to seriously study the Judicial Integrity Education Reader, the Basic Norms of Professional Ethics for Judges, the Code of Conduct for Judges (Trial), and various integrity systems and disciplinary regulations of the courts. This is to enable all judges and other staff to continuously enhance their awareness of judicial integrity and consciously resist money worship, hedonism, and extreme individualism. They must implement the Opinions on Strengthening Regular Education for Party Members, conscientiously implement the system of "Three Meetings and One Lesson," and continuously enhance the Party spirit of judges and other staff. Through solid and effective education on ideals and beliefs, Party discipline and national law, and professional ethics, all judges and other staff must firmly build an ideological and moral defense line against corruption and degeneration.

In accordance with the requirements of the Work Plan to innovate forms of warning education, people's courts at all levels must conscientiously carry out warning education and continuously enhance judges' awareness of judicial integrity. They must be skilled in using negative examples from their own regions and courts to conduct education. Where conditions permit, they may establish anti-corruption and integrity warning education bases, adhere to regular warning education, and continuously improve the targetedness and effectiveness of warning education.

People's courts at all levels must improve the assessment system for anti-corruption and integrity education, clarify assessment methods and standards, and link assessment results with evaluations and commendations. They must establish and improve the inspection system for anti-corruption and integrity education. Higher courts should conduct annual inspections of the anti-corruption and integrity education carried out by some lower courts.

(3) Strengthening the Culture of Integrity in the People's Courts

The Work Plan emphasizes the need to strengthen the culture of integrity. People's courts at all levels must, centering on the socialist core value system, carry out a variety of creative activities to establish a culture of integrity in the courts. After the Guiding Opinions on Strengthening the Construction of a Culture of Integrity proposed in the Work Plan is formulated and issued, people's courts at all levels must implement it conscientiously, fully leveraging the guiding, educational, motivational, and normative roles of the court's integrity culture to provide a strong guarantee for the court's anti-corruption and integrity building. They must strengthen the carrier construction of the court's integrity culture, using forms such as knowledge competitions, picture exhibitions, speech contests, theatrical performances, warning education videos, hanging maxims and calligraphy/painting works in office areas, local area network columns, and巡回 (itinerant) presentations to expand coverage, enhance influence, and actively create a cultural atmosphere in the courts of "honoring integrity and regarding corruption as shameful."

3. Improving Anti-Corruption and Integrity Systems

(1) Conscientiously Implementing and Improving the System of Intra-Party Democracy

Party Leadership Groups of people's courts at all levels must strictly implement democratic centralism, adhere to the principles of collective leadership, democratic centralism, individual deliberation, and decision by meeting, and continuously improve democratic decision-making mechanisms in light of court realities. After the Regulations on the Work of Party Leadership Groups of the Communist Party of China proposed in the Work Plan is formulated and issued, they must study and implement it conscientiously, effectively playing the core leadership role of the Party Leadership Group. After the Opinions on Implementing Open Party Affairs in Local and Grassroots Party Organizations proposed in the Work Plan is formulated and issued, they must comprehensively implement various regulations on open Party affairs, allowing more Party members to understand and participate in the management affairs of Party organizations.

(2) Conscientiously Implementing and Improving Systems for Punishing Disciplinary Violations

After the supporting regulations for the Regulations of the Communist Party of China on Disciplinary Sanctions, the Several Opinions on Handling Cases by Discipline Inspection and Supervision Organs in Accordance with Laws and Regulations and Standardizing Case Handling, and the Regulations of the Communist Party of China Discipline Inspection Organs on Complaints and Appeals proposed in the Work Plan are formulated or revised and issued, people's courts at all levels must strictly implement them.

People's courts at all levels must conscientiously implement the Regulations on the Supervision Work of the People's Courts, strengthen supervisory functions, improve supervisory methods, increase supervisory efforts, and make the supervision work of the people's courts more adaptable to the needs of anti-corruption and integrity building in the people's courts, ensuring the correct implementation of national laws and regulations and ensuring judicial fairness and integrity. By the end of 2008, the Supreme People's Court must formulate the Regulations on Disciplinary Sanctions for the People's Courts and the Procedural Rules for Punishment of Judges for Disciplinary Violations. People's courts at all levels must conscientiously implement the above normative documents.

(3) Conscientiously Implementing and Improving the Responsibility System for Party Conduct and Integrity Building

After the revised Provisions on Implementing the Responsibility System for Party Conduct and Integrity Building proposed in the Work Plan is issued, people's courts at all levels must formulate implementation measures in light of their actual circumstances, further clarify leadership responsibilities, strengthen assessment, supervision, and inspection, strictly pursue accountability, and fully leverage the leading role of the responsibility system for Party conduct and integrity building in anti-corruption and integrity building.

4. Strengthening Supervision and Constraints

(1) Strengthening Supervision over Leadership Groups and Leading Cadres

In accordance with the requirements of the Work Plan, people's courts at all levels must strengthen supervision over the compliance of leadership groups and leading cadres with the Party's political discipline. People's courts at all levels must adhere to the correct political direction in court work, always adhere to the theoretical system of socialism with Chinese characteristics without wavering, adhere to the socialist rule of law concept without wavering, adhere to the socialist judicial system with Chinese characteristics without wavering, continuously increase efforts to enforce political discipline, safeguard the Party Constitution and other intra-Party regulations, safeguard the authority of the Central Committee and the centralized unity of the Party, always maintain a high degree of consistency with the Party Central Committee with Comrade Hu Jintao as General Secretary, and ensure the implementation of the Party's line, principles, and policies in the people's courts, and ensure the comprehensive implementation of the major theoretical viewpoints, major strategic thoughts, and major work deployments determined by the Seventeenth National Congress of the Communist Party of China in the people's courts.

Strengthen supervision over the implementation of the Scientific Outlook on Development. People's courts at all levels must take the Scientific Outlook on Development as the overall guideline for their work, deepen their understanding of the laws governing court work in accordance with the requirements of the Scientific Outlook on Development, and strive to pay more attention to promoting development, promoting harmony, ensuring people's livelihood, and maintaining national security and social stability. They must balance procedural justice and substantive justice, balance lawful adjudication and litigation mediation, balance the protection of human rights of criminal defendants and the feelings of victims and the public, balance the establishment of judicial authority and extensive acceptance of social supervision, and balance the professionalism of judicial work and adherence to the mass line, preventing and correcting behaviors that violate the requirements of the Scientific Outlook on Development.

Strengthen supervision over the implementation of democratic centralism. People's courts at all levels must conscientiously carry out supervision and inspection of the implementation of democratic centralism on issues involving overall situations, recommendation and appointment of important cadres, arrangement and use of large amounts of funds, and rewards and punishments, ensuring strict implementation of the rules of procedure and decision-making procedures of the Party Leadership Group meetings, opposing and preventing arbitrary decisions by individuals or a minority.

Strengthen supervision over the implementation of the provisions on integrity and self-discipline for leading cadres. After the revised Several Guidelines for Integrity and Self-Discipline of Communist Party of China Leading Cadres (Trial) proposed in the Work Plan is issued, leading cadres who are Party members of the people's courts must seriously study and model abide by various standards of conduct for clean governance, maintain integrity and honesty, and never seek personal gain by abusing power. They must focus on addressing issues such as leading cadres violating regulations by accepting cash, securities, payment instruments, and dry shares, illegally intervening in cases, and seeking personal gain in housing. They must strictly implement the provisions on the personal business of the spouses and children of leading cadres.

Strengthen the supervision of higher people's courts over the leadership groups and leading cadres of lower people's courts. The Supreme People's Court must, in accordance with the Interim Measures on Inspection Tours, conscientiously carry out inspection tours of higher people's courts regarding their implementation of the Scientific Outlook on Development, execution of the Party's line, principles, policies, resolutions, decisions, and national laws and regulations, implementation of major decisions and work deployments of the Supreme People's Court, implementation of democratic centralism, implementation of the responsibility system for Party conduct and integrity building, selection and appointment of cadres, and the conduct of leading cadres. Higher and intermediate people's courts may also carry out inspection tours in light of actual circumstances.

(2) Strengthening Supervision over the Exercise of Power in Important Departments and Key Positions

Conscientiously implement the requirements of the Work Plan on strengthening supervision over the exercise of power in important areas and key links. Strengthen supervision over the exercise of personnel power. Implement the Regulations on the Selection and Appointment of Party and Government Leading Cadres and the Measures for Supervision and Inspection of the Selection and Appointment of Party and Government Leading Cadres (Trial). Adhere to and improve the system of soliciting opinions from discipline inspection and supervision departments before the selection and appointment of cadres. Strengthen supervision over the entire process of selection and appointment of cadres, prevent distortion in assessments and cadres being "promoted despite defects." Seriously investigate and deal with issues such as seeking official positions, buying and selling official positions, and resolutely rectify unhealthy practices in personnel selection.

Strengthen internal supervision over the exercise of judicial power in the people's courts. Strengthen supervision by higher people's courts over the trial work of lower people's courts. Higher people's courts must strengthen trial level supervision in accordance with the law, and resolutely handle cases that should be remanded for retrial or modified in accordance with the law. Improve the retrial system, maintain judicial authority, correct erroneous judgments in accordance with the law, and protect the legitimate rights and interests of parties. Improve the working mechanism for higher people's courts to effectively implement unified management and coordination of the enforcement work of lower people's courts, preventing the abuse of enforcement power. Further improve supervision working mechanisms such as trial and enforcement process management and case quality evaluation.

Strengthen supervision by court presidents and division chiefs over trial personnel and enforcement personnel. Scientifically set supervisory responsibilities for court presidents and division chiefs that correspond to their positions, guiding and supervising trial personnel and enforcement personnel to handle cases fairly and in accordance with the law. Regard the integrity supervision of trial and enforcement work as an important responsibility of leading cadres at all levels of the courts and in trial and enforcement departments, incorporate it into the responsibility system for Party conduct and integrity building of court leading cadres, and establish a working pattern where integrity supervision is implemented at each level. Court presidents and division chiefs must implement dynamic supervision through methods such as receiving visitors, handling letters, observing trials, and guiding case handling.

Strengthen supervision over the use of funds and financial management. Conscientiously implement various rules and regulations on financial management, carry out supervision and inspection of government procurement, implementation of the "separate revenue and expenditure" system, and management of state-owned assets, and continue to conduct special clean-ups of "off-the-books funds."

(3) Strengthening and Improving Intra-Party Supervision

The Work Plan emphasizes the need to strengthen and improve intra-Party supervision. Leadership groups of the courts at all levels must effectively improve the forms and methods of democratic life meetings, enhance the principle of intra-Party political life, actively engage in criticism and self-criticism, and strengthen mutual supervision among members of the leadership group. Adhere to the system of leading cadres participating in dual organizational life, accepting supervision from Party members and the masses. Implement the provisions on leading cadres reporting personal matters, and implement the systems for leading cadres to report their work and integrity, admonition conversations, and correspondence inquiries. Promote openness in Party affairs, respect the principal status of Party members, implement the responsibilities and rights of Party members in intra-Party supervision, and create an environment for democratic discussion within the Party. Conscientiously implement the Regulations on the Protection of Rights of Communist Party of China Members, and effectively protect the rights of Party members to criticize, make suggestions, and report. Discipline inspection and supervision departments of courts at all levels must conscientiously fulfill their supervision responsibilities while consciously accepting supervision.

(4) Consciously Accepting Supervision by the People's Congress, Legal Supervision, and Social Supervision

People's courts at all levels must, in accordance with the requirements of the Work Plan, consciously accept supervision by the People's Congress. Conscientiously implement the Several Opinions on the People's Courts Accepting Supervision by the People's Congress and Its Standing Committee, report work to the People's Congress and its Standing Committee at the same level responsibly, and carefully listen to and promptly respond to criticisms and suggestions from People's Congress deputies on court work. In accordance with the requirements of the Work Plan, they must consciously accept legal supervision by the procuratorial organs. Cases protested by the procuratorial organs must be carefully tried, and written opinions from the procuratorial organs must be seriously treated. In accordance with the requirements of the Work Plan, they must consciously accept social supervision. Carefully listen to criticisms and opinions from all sectors of society and the masses, continuously improve work; value and support news media in correctly conducting supervision by public opinion, continuously enhance the consciousness of accepting supervision by public opinion; in response to reports of violations of laws and discipline or corruption by court staff, promptly organize forces to verify; once verified, deal with them seriously.

5. Deepening Reform of Systems, Mechanisms, and Institutions

(1) Advancing Reform of the Judicial Personnel Management System

People's courts at all levels must, in accordance with the requirements of the Work Plan to promote the reform of the cadre personnel system, improve the system for the selection and appointment of cadres. Adhere to the principles of democracy, openness, competition, and merit selection, forming a scientific mechanism for the selection and appointment of cadres. Improve methods such as open selection, competitive appointment, and differential election, focus on solving problems such as vote-buying and election-rigging in democratic recommendations, democratic evaluations, and elections, and increase public trust in the selection and use of personnel. Improve the systems for the term of office, avoidance, and exchange of leading cadres. Improve the cadre assessment and evaluation system, and leverage the role of assessment results in cadre appointment and supervision management. Actively promote the classified management of staff in the people's courts.

We must reform the selection procedures and appointment mechanisms for judges, explore the establishment of a system for unified recruitment and unified assignment of judges to grassroots people's courts within a certain region, and establish a judge job sequence that conforms to the professional characteristics of judges and the laws of trial work. We must establish a pre-service training system for judges, reform the on-the-job training system for judges, and reform the training content, methods, management system, and the selection of teachers for judge training institutions. We must implement the provisions of the Judges Law, promote the establishment and improvement of appointment, promotion, reward, pension, medical insurance, and salary, welfare, and allowance systems suitable for the professional characteristics of judges, and gradually improve the treatment of judges.

(2) Promoting the reform of the judicial system and working mechanisms

In accordance with the requirements of the Work Plan, it is necessary to further optimize the allocation of internal judicial powers within the people's courts. It is necessary to optimize the allocation of powers between higher and lower courts and build a more scientific trial level management system; optimize the allocation of powers between trial and enforcement business departments and between them and comprehensive management departments, and solve problems such as unclear definition of responsibilities, overlapping, and lack of supervision in some departments. Improve the conditions and adjudication procedures for commutation of sentence, parole, medical parole, temporary service outside prison, and change of place of incarceration. Continue to promote the reform of the system for open trials and enforcement, actively explore the system for online publication of civil and commercial judgment documents, actively explore the system for online inquiry of enforcement case information, accelerate the construction of a nationwide court case information inquiry and supervision system, and establish a more reasonable, timely, transparent, effective, and scientific judicial openness system. Improve the systems for investigating the responsibility of trial personnel and enforcement personnel for illegal trials and illegal enforcement, and for investigating the responsibility of leading cadres for dereliction of duty. Improve the working mechanism for litigation-related petitions. Reform and improve the judicial management system and the judicial financial guarantee mechanism. Improve the system for uniform application of law, standardize the exercise of discretion by trial personnel, and ensure strict, fair, and civilized justice.

6. Rectifying unhealthy practices that harm the interests of the masses

(1) In-depth special rectification work

The Work Plan emphasizes the need to carry out special rectification in depth. People's courts at all levels must closely focus on the issues of greatest concern to the people, the most direct interests, and the most realistic interests, strengthen supervision and inspection of discipline and law enforcement, and resolutely correct unhealthy practices that harm the interests of the masses. Carry out special rectification of trial court demeanor, persist in regular special inspections of trial court demeanor, and promptly correct problems such as judges' indecorous bearing, uncivilized language, unserious behavior, and non-standard attire during trials. Carry out special rectification of arbitrary charges, strictly implement the State Council's "Measures for Payment of Litigation Costs" and the "Provisions on the Supervision and Management of Litigation Fees" issued by the Supreme People's Court, and resolutely prevent and correct arbitrary charges and other practices. Carry out special rectification of the management of enforcement funds and property, promptly return enforcement proceeds to creditors, strictly prohibit misappropriation of enforcement funds and property, and any violation of regulations in misappropriating enforcement funds and property shall be dealt with according to discipline and law.

(2) Establish and improve long-term mechanisms for preventing and correcting unhealthy practices

In accordance with the requirements of the Work Plan for establishing and improving long-term mechanisms for preventing and correcting unhealthy practices, people's courts at all levels must adhere to the principles of addressing both symptoms and root causes, combining correction with construction, and maintaining persistent efforts against unhealthy practices that harm the interests of the masses. Establish and improve supervision and inspection mechanisms, regularly carry out special inspections, promptly correct nascent and trend-setting issues, and prevent their spread into a trend. In accordance with the requirements of the Work Plan, hold regular symposiums to listen to the opinions and suggestions of the people regarding court work. Improve the petition work mechanism, and urge relevant departments to promptly resolve the reasonable demands of the people. Conscientiously implement the accountability system, and effectively safeguard the legitimate rights and interests of the people.

7. Maintaining a strong momentum in punishing corruption

(1) Resolutely investigate and handle cases of disciplinary and legal violations

The Work Plan emphasizes the need to resolutely investigate and handle cases of disciplinary and legal violations. People's courts at all levels must adhere to the principle that everyone is equal before the law and discipline, and any corrupt element must be severely punished according to law, with no leniency. Focus on investigating and handling cases of abuse of power, embezzlement and bribery, dereliction of duty and malfeasance by leading cadres in courts; cases of engaging in malpractices for personal gain, bending the law to favor relatives or friends, deliberately delaying case handling by judges in trial and enforcement work; and cases that seriously infringe upon the interests of the masses. Where any of the above disciplinary or legal violations occur, they shall be resolutely given Party disciplinary or administrative sanctions according to discipline and law.

(2) Seriously investigate and handle acts violating trial discipline that are strongly reflected by the masses

All judges and other staff must strictly implement trial discipline. They must not accept property or gifts, or accept meals, from parties, their defenders, agents, or entrusting persons; must not meet privately with parties, their defenders, or agents; must not introduce lawyers to parties or introduce representation cases to lawyers; must not intercede or mediate relationships for parties; must not improperly designate or introduce intermediary agencies to seek benefits, or collude with intermediary agencies to engage in malpractices or fraud; must not disclose trial secrets. Anyone who commits any of the above acts must be seriously dealt with according to discipline and law.

(3) Strengthen petitioning and reporting work

People's courts at all levels must conscientiously implement the requirements set forth in the Work Plan to improve the petitioning and reporting working mechanism and smooth the channels for petitions, diligently do a good job in petitioning and reporting work, and strive to discover clues of disciplinary and legal violations from such work. Broaden the channels for petitioning and reporting, set up reporting telephone numbers, and make them public. Improve the feedback and reply system for real-name reports. Pay attention to discovering clues of disciplinary and legal violations from major law enforcement inspections, special inspections, and case evaluations.

(4) Strictly handle cases according to discipline and law

The Work Plan requires adherence to handling cases according to discipline and law. People's courts at all levels must integrate handling cases according to discipline and law into all stages including case filing, investigation, adjudication, sanction, and enforcement. Based on specific circumstances, achieve a combination of leniency and severity. Comprehensively utilize both disciplinary sanctions and organizational measures. For judges and other staff who are subjected to false accusations, mistaken accusations, or retaliation, promptly clarify the situation and effectively protect them.

(5) Strengthen leadership and guidance over the investigation and handling of cases, and establish a coordination mechanism for investigating and handling cases

Leading cadres of people's courts at all levels, especially the principal leading cadres, must strengthen leadership over the work of investigating and handling cases, strongly support disciplinary inspection and supervision departments in investigating and handling cases, and hold accountable those leading cadres who fail to investigate cases when there are cases, suppress cases without handling them, or even interfere with case handling.

Strengthen guidance over the work of investigating and handling cases by lower people's courts. Higher people's courts must promptly guide and support lower people's courts in investigating and handling disciplinary and legal violations. Where coordination by a higher people's court is needed, it shall conscientiously and responsibly carry out such coordination; promptly respond to inquiries from lower people's courts regarding the application of discipline and law.

Explore a case-handling mechanism for mutual cooperation between the supervision departments of people's courts and disciplinary inspection organs. The supervision departments of people's courts at all levels must earnestly perform their supervision functions, take the initiative to play a role, strengthen contact and cooperation with disciplinary inspection organs, actively participate in the preliminary verification and investigation of court staff by disciplinary inspection organs, and continuously improve the level of case handling.

Explore a working mechanism for mutual communication between the supervision departments of people's courts and the procuratorial organs. The supervision departments of people's courts at all levels should proactively communicate with the procuratorial organs, exchange information in a timely manner, and proactively investigate and handle disciplinary and legal violations.

(6) Leverage the comprehensive effects of investigating and handling cases

People's courts at all levels must conscientiously implement the requirements of the Work Plan regarding leveraging the comprehensive effects of investigating and handling cases, deeply analyze the problems exposed in disciplinary and legal violation cases, summarize lessons, take them as warnings, improve systems, plug loopholes, and continuously increase and expand the intensity and scope of work on addressing root causes.

8. Effectively implement the Implementation Measures

(1) Strengthen leadership and clarify division of responsibilities

The Party Leading Groups of people's courts at all levels are the main bodies responsible for anti-corruption construction, bearing the political responsibility of comprehensively leading the construction of the system for punishing and preventing corruption. They must effectively strengthen leadership, take the implementation of the Implementation Measures as a political task, place it on the important agenda of the Party Leading Group, and deploy, implement, and inspect it together with trial work and other work. Strictly implement the responsibility system for improving Party conduct and building integrity. The Secretary of the Party Leading Group assumes overall responsibility, and other members of the leadership team manage work within their respective divisions according to the division of responsibilities, implementing joint management by the Party and administrative leaders. The disciplinary inspection and supervision departments of people's courts at all levels must fully perform their duties, assist the Party Leading Group in decomposing and implementing the tasks of the Implementation Measures, formulate implementation plans, make specific arrangements, and ensure the implementation of the work.

(2) Form a joint force and firmly implement

People's courts at all levels must decompose tasks in accordance with the overall requirements of the Implementation Measures, clarify the departments responsible for completing each task, and implement work responsibilities. All departments must closely cooperate, support each other, form a joint force, and ensure the completion of work tasks. Seize the key and difficult issues in the construction of the system for punishing and preventing corruption, concentrate forces to achieve breakthroughs, and thereby promote the work. Strengthen investigation and research, deeply understand the new situations and new problems in the implementation of the Implementation Measures, propose new ideas and new measures to advance anti-corruption construction, explore new pathways and new methods, continuously improve the level of work, and strive to achieve obvious results.

(3) Supervision, inspection, and strict assessment

People's courts at all levels must conduct special inspections of work progress each year, summarize experiences, promote work, and report to the higher people's court. Include the implementation of the Implementation Measures in the scope of assessment and evaluation of leadership teams and leading cadres, as an important part of performance evaluation and cadre rewards and punishments, strictly assess responsibilities, and strengthen accountability. Higher people's courts must strengthen supervision and inspection, implement categorized guidance, and ensure that the tasks set forth in the Implementation Measures are carried out.
